notes.workersFree: Workers Free: 100,000 requests a day, 10 ms of CPU per request, no fee. Requests to static assets are free and unlimited.
notes.doFree: Durable Objects on Workers Free (SQLite-backed only): 100,000 requests, 13,000 GB-s, 5 million rows read and 100,000 rows written a day; 5 GB stored in total.
notes.ws: A request is needed to create a WebSocket connection. For billing only, a 20:1 ratio is applied to incoming WebSocket messages; outgoing messages and incoming protocol pings aren't charged; auto-responses (setWebSocketAutoResponse) aren't charged.
notes.alarm: Each setAlarm() is billed as a single row written; deletes are counted as rows written.
notes.duration: Duration bills the 128 MB a Durable Object is allocated, whatever it uses; an object that is idle and eligible for hibernation isn't billed for duration.
notes.r2: R2 bills on either Workers plan; its free amounts are monthly and apply to Standard storage only. Storage is the average of each day's peak over the month. Egress is free. DeleteObject and AbortMultipartUpload are free.
notes.dailyReset: Workers Free daily limits reset at 00:00 UTC.
notes.rounding: Durable Objects: "billable usage is the amount consumed in excess of the included monthly allocation. This billable usage is rounded up to the next billable unit" (a million requests, GB-s or rows; a GB-month). R2: "Cloudflare rounds up your usage to the next billing unit" (a million operations, a GB-month). Workers requests and CPU: no rounding documented.
notes.perObject: A SQLite-backed Durable Object holds at most 10 GB on Workers Paid, 1 GB on the Free plan; past it, writes fail (SQLITE_FULL) while reads and deletes still work.
notes.durationShared: Duration is billed in wall-clock time while the object is active, shared across all requests active on it at once.

documentedLimits.value: 1 GB in one Durable Object on Free, 10 GB on Paid (Cloudflare's Durable Objects limits page)
documentedLimits.observed: Not pushed to the limit. The lab's 1 GiB vault uploads (1.07 GB) completed in one vault on Workers Free (2026-11-01 and 11-02), so the 1 GB wasn't enforced at that size.
documentedLimits.carton: Without R2, a project's media all sits in one vault object, so the media it keeps must fit this, on either plan. Past it, writes fail (SQLITE_FULL); reads and deletes still work. Keep media in R2.

documentedLimits.value: R2: 10 GB-month of storage, 1 million Class A and 10 million Class B a month free, on either Workers plan
documentedLimits.observed: The lab stayed far under it (its R2 use is in CF-VERIFY.md).
documentedLimits.carton: Past it, R2 bills; it never stops working. Its free amounts are monthly, not daily.
